sections.heading: Welcome aboard Queen Anne
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D guide, not affiliated with Cunard. Queen Anne offers contemporary dining, entertainment and wellness. Confirm current services with Cunard.

sections.heading: Official ship and deck plans
sections.body:
Official Cunard Queen Anne information and interactive deck plans (internet required): https://www.cunard.com/en-gb/cruise-ships/queen-anne
Select a deck on the official website for the latest locations.

sections.heading: Deck reference
sections.body: Use Cunard’s current Queen Anne deck plan to locate staterooms, lifts, accessible routes and venues. Decks and facilities can change.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Queen Anne offers Britannia and Grill restaurants, Artisans’ Foodhall, Aji Wa, Aranya, Tramonto and Sir Samuel’s Steakhouse & Grill. Your main dining allocation depends on your stateroom category; check availability, reservations and charges.

sections.heading: Bars and lounges
sections.body: Enjoy the Commodore Club, Chart Room, Golden Lion, Carinthia Lounge, Lobby Bar, Room 1840, Sky Bar and Pavilion Bar. Check hours and access onboard.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Queen Anne features Bright Lights Society, Royal Court Theatre, Queens Room and The Pavilion. Daily programmes vary by voyage.

sections.heading: Wellness and outdoor spaces
sections.body: Mareel Wellness & Beauty, Pavilion Wellness Studio, Pavilion Pool, Panorama Pool Club and outdoor observation spaces. Confirm access and fees.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check passport, visa and entry requirements, travel insurance, luggage labels, boarding instructions and Cunard’s current advice.

sections.heading: First day onboard
sections.body: Find your cabin, review muster arrangements and check dining details and the daily programme.

sections.heading: Ports and excursions
sections.body: Record meeting points, excursions and all-aboard times. Follow the ship’s official schedule.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Personal notes are stored on your device. External official links require internet access. This independent app does not connect to Cunard onboard systems.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Unofficial independent passenger companion, not endorsed by or affiliated with Cunard. Confirm prices, opening hours and deck details with Cunard.
